findings.passage: I support making Election Day a federal holiday and extending early voting to all states to make participation easier for working Americans. I also back automatic voter registration, Ranked Choice & Approval Voting to eliminate the idea of wasted votes, repealing Citizens United, and banning corporate PAC money to limit the corrosive influence of big money in our elections.
findings.note: Campaign site issue text on voting reforms: supports a federal Election Day holiday, early voting in all states and automatic voter registration. It says nothing about ID or citizenship proof. Page undated; date is when it was read.
